name: needs_owner_call_back
party: Thornfield Auto, a repair shop in Columbus. The morning the owner asked for is full; it offers Thursday at 10 am, which only the owner can accept, and asks for a call back. Nothing is booked.

steps.voice: Hi Priya, I'm an AI assistant calling for a customer. I'd like to book an oil change on Tuesday, February 23rd, in the morning.

steps.say: Tuesday the 23rd is completely full, I'm afraid. The soonest I have is Thursday the 25th at 10 am.
I can't hold it without the customer saying yes, so they'll need to call us back if Thursday works.
Sure, have them give us a call. Bye now.
